_comment: Multiplayer (work order 188 Part 7). Every word here is ARTWORK in the original — MULTIGM.LBX's buttons and panels (multplay.cpp:206-231, :656-675, :828-861; hotpop.cpp:32-38) — typed from the native frames of work order 188 (evidence P7_explore), per decision 15; a mod replaces this file. Two are named by what orion2re does rather than by the art: ONLINE (the art says MODEM) and ENDPOINT (the one live box of the art's MODEM CONNECT panel) — DEVIATION online_word.

marks.deviation_hud_panels: HUD panels on the universal background, where the original draws MULTIGM.LBX's pictures and animations (the setup's frame, the waiting animations).
marks.deviation_online_word: The radio the art calls MODEM and the dialog it calls MODEM CONNECT are ONLINE and its ENDPOINT: orion2re replaced the modem with a direct TCP endpoint (netcode.cpp:266-275, docs/networking.md), and the MODEM CONNECT panel's other boxes (COM port, baud rate, phone number, modem strings) take no input.
